# Invalid task data makes check and sync fail; sync leaves the projection intact.
exec tuck$exe init
cp malformed-task.md tasks/todo/001-invalid-task.md
cp invalid-yaml.md tasks/todo/002-invalid-yaml.md
cp missing-id.md tasks/todo/003-missing-id.md
cp no-heading.md tasks/todo/004-no-heading.md
cp nested-metadata.md tasks/todo/005-nested-metadata.md
cp board.md projection-before.md

exitcode 1 init --json
stderr 'existing board is invalid'

exitcode 1 check --json
json
stdout '"ok": false'
stdout 'task must begin with YAML front matter'
stdout 'malformed front matter'
stdout 'missing required field'
stdout 'task needs a first-level heading'
stdout 'flat arrays are supported'
stderr 'found 5 board issue'

exitcode 1 sync --json
json
stdout '"synced": false'
stdout 'task must begin with YAML front matter'
stdout 'malformed front matter'
stderr 'warning: tasks/todo/001-invalid-task.md'
stderr 'board.md was left untouched'
cmp board.md projection-before.md

This file is not a Tuck task.

---
# Malformed YAML
-- missing-id.md --

order: 3
created_at: "2026-09-19T12:32:00Z"
---
# Missing ID
